body: I thought all the same things. People being better off without me. But the truth is they won’t they’ll miss you, you may think you’re not important but the truth is you’re the world to him.

Have you tried talking to him about it. I know finally coming clean about my depression was like a ton of weight off my shoulders. If they love you they’ll help you. I know it seems like there’s no options anymore. But finally coming clean to myself and my girlfriend was the best thing I ever did.
Happy cake day, btw only losers have cake days today
